newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bastia airport freight & mail traffic up five pct.
newsitem.headline: Bastia airport freight & mail traffic up five pct.

text.p: Bastia's Poretta airport handled 1,470 tonnes of airfreight in the first nine months of 1996, an increase of five percent on the same period last year.
Air France Europe is the main operator at Bastia with daily passenger services between Orly and the northern Corsican city using Airbus 320 aircraft.
Air Littoral also operates an all-cargo charter service on behalf of French parcel delivery groups, Calberson and Sernam, using one of its five-tonne capacity HS748 aircraft.
This flies nightly on a Marseille/Bastia/Ajaccio/Marseille itinerary.
Postal traffic totalled 4,345 tonnes, up 10 percent on 1995 levels, the airport authority said.
French carrier, L'Aeropostale, carries postal freight between its Paris-CDG hub and Bastia using Boeing 737QC (quick change) aircraft.
